primary_title: Inflammatory cytokines stimulate the chemokines CCL2/MCP-1 and CCL7/MCP-3 through NFkB and MAPK dependent pathways in rat astrocytes [corrected]
decision_basis: The reviews identify TNF-alpha as an astrocyte inflammatory chemokine inducer; the cited corrected primary demonstrates concentration- and time-dependent CCL2/MCP-1 protein production from rat astrocytes after TNF-alpha, with NF-kappaB and p38/JNK pathway inhibitor sensitivity.
limitations_preserved: Secreted chemokine-output bridge only; preserve corrected-paper/erratum status, rat astrocyte and inhibitor context, distinguish CCL2 protein release from CCL2 gene induction and later CCR2 binding, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.
